summary.headline: Planetary Falls and Delayed Events
summary.text: Astrological judgment on planetary falls from the angles and elevations, explaining how Venus, Saturn, the Moon, and the Sun affect the timing, delay, or acceleration of an event. Planets falling from angles delay expected events but favor the return of absent travelers, pilgrims, prefects, or kings.
